about: Fingerprints of what the Economy tab computed and drew on commit 8cc851a, in English (tests/browser/make_golden.js). tests/core.test.js compares the shared engine with it. The tourism-place datasets (the five keys that read municipalities.json) were fingerprinted again on 2026-10-18, after the counts left out the listings that are not tourism (HANDOFF decision 47), and again after the follow-up of PR #62 withheld 20 more listings the same day; the engine code did not change. FEMA Public Assistance (fema_pa_obligated) and the layer stacks that draw it (fema_pa_symbols_2018, three_layers_2017) were fingerprinted again on 2026-10-30, after the OpenFEMA download of that day (Public money v2, step 1); the engine code did not change.
